caseName: Estes v. Metropolitan Branches of the Dallas NAACP
caseNameFull: Estes v. Metropolitan Branches of the Dallas NAACP Curry v. Metropolitan Branches of the Dallas NAACP and Brinegar v. Metropolitan Branches of the Dallas NAACP

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 440 U. S. 906.] Motion of Dallas Alliance et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of petitioners Brinegar et al. for additional time for oral argument granted, and 15 additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Respondents also allotted 15 additional minutes for oral argument.

Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
